messages.content: Use the data from dataset.csv file and fit a linear regression model to predict future sales by setting x=data['sales'] and y=data['future_sales']. Additionally, calculate and return the residuals.

function.description: Load data from a csv file into a data structure. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.
